summary.text: Marie Alvarado-Gil, a Republican, represents the 4th Senate District in the California State Senate.

paragraphs.text: Her Senate website says she was elected in 2022, earned bachelor's and master's degrees in public administration from the University of San Francisco, and lives in Amador County.

The Ceres Courier reported, based on unofficial results, that Alvarado-Gil placed third in the June 2, 2026 primary behind Jaron Brandon and Alexandra Duarte, the two candidates advancing to the November 3 general election.

sources.title: Alvarado-Gil appears headed for retirement from Senate seat
